title: The network device must be configured to compare the internal system clocks on an organization-defined frequency with organization-defined authoritative time source.
check_content:
Verify the network device is configured to compare the internal system clocks on an organization-defined frequency with organization-defined authoritative time source.

If the network device is not configured to compare the internal system clocks on an organization-defined frequency with organization-defined authoritative time source, this is a finding.
fixtext: Configure the network device to compare the internal system clocks on an organization-defined frequency with organization-defined authoritative time source.
VulnDiscussion: Synchronization of internal system clocks with an authoritative source provides uniformity of time stamps for systems with multiple system clocks and systems connected over a network.
